status: DEVELOPMENT — authored 2026-11-04 for the model-independent answer harness (scripts/answer-eval-harness.mjs). No answers were generated against it in this mission.

criteria.current: the answer gives the current value (`include`) and never presents a retired value (`notCurrent`) as current — a retired value may appear only in a sentence that marks it as past
criteria.historical: the answer gives the earlier value (`include`)
criteria.goal_status: the answer gives the goal's status: achieved goals are not presented as open (`notOpen`), open goals are named (`include`)
criteria.uncertain_dependency: the answer neither asserts nor dismisses a record that depends on a changed fact: it names it and hedges or asks (`hedge`)
criteria.personal_context: the answer uses at least one relevant personal fact (`include`)
criteria.unsupported: the answer names no person, organisation or value absent from the context and the question (scored on every answer)
criteria.abstention: the answer says it does not know (`abstain`) and invents no value
